collection.title: Mercedes-Benz Vaneo 2004 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz Vaneo 2004 to 2005 (414) requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 26" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
